scope: Additive Rage Gem L1-18 Grand Warden passive damage aura audit for standard Home Village combat.
game_version: Official December 2023 Equipment release; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Rage Gem is Common passive Grand Warden Equipment unlocked at Blacksmith level 4.
Nearby friendly units do extra damage; the Warden receives separate DPS and attack-speed bonuses.
sources.limitations: No aura radius, eligible entity classes, damage formula, stacking, rounding or timing contract.

sources.title: Home Village Balance Changes - September 2024
facts: The dated report lists September 2024 L1-14 damage-boost reductions to 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 percent bands, matching pinned raw fields.
sources.limitations: It does not give post-2024 continuity, L15-18 values, aura geometry or stacking rules.

sources.title: Rage Gem — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated L1-18 Warden DPS 12-88, ore costs and Blacksmith requirements match pinned raw fields.
The page repeats the nearby-friendly-unit damage description.
sources.limitations: Does not show the L1-18 aura damage percentages or Warden attack-speed series, and gives no geometry or stacking rules.

sources.title: Pinned Rage Gem Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned L1-18 payload has damageIncreasePercent 15-50 percent, Warden dpsIncrease 12-88 and attackSpeedIncrease +5 to +22 percent.
sources.limitations: No current September 2026 confirmation of the exact aura and attack-speed series, and no radius, eligible classes, damage staging or stack rules.

observations.note: Dated 2024 table corroborates L1-14 aura bands and dated 2026 table corroborates Warden DPS; attack-speed and L15-18 aura effects need current-value confirmation.

derivations.result: Retain pinned aura percentages, Warden bonuses and upgrade fields as catalogue data
derivations.method: Compare dated Warden DPS and ore rows against raw L1-18; distinguish the unit aura from the Warden's separate DPS/attack-speed fields.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the passive aura damage percentage to the Warden's own attacks
rejected_inferences.reason: The official description separates nearby-friendly-unit damage from the Warden's own DPS and attack-speed bonuses; self-inclusion is not established.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat Rage Gem as a Rage Spell or add movement speed
rejected_inferences.reason: The Equipment source specifies extra damage only for nearby units; Spell behavior and speed do not transfer.

rejected_inferences.rule: Reuse Life Gem or Eternal Tome aura geometry
rejected_inferences.reason: A shared Warden visual ring does not source identical radius, edge or eligibility filters.

rejected_inferences.rule: Multiply all outgoing damage and stack with other Rage effects
rejected_inferences.reason: Damage origin filters, buff stacking, per-shot rounding and projectiles already in flight are undocumented.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply or remove the aura immediately on deployment, movement or revival
rejected_inferences.reason: The activation phase, death/revival lifecycle and same-tick ordering are not given.

items: current L1-18 aura and Warden attack-speed value continuity
aura center, radius, boundary and eligible Hero/Pet/Troop/child classes
damage origin, hit versus DPS staging, integer rounding and projectile carryover
stacking with Rage Spell, Rage Vial, Royal Rampage and other buffs
Warden self-inclusion, death, Phoenix revival and defensive use
deployment, movement, aura refresh, attack and damage tick order
Viewer aura overlay, snapshot, replay and RL state

conclusion: Rage Gem L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official evidence establishes a passive nearby-unit damage aura and separate Warden DPS/attack-speed bonuses, but current effect values, geometry, stacking and tick order remain unresolved.
